R7AB-bear-backcountry-0001.name: 150 m NE of Grain Creek
R7AB-bear-backcountry-0001.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).

evidence.t: Burn from 2017 (fire C31169), 140 m E: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
W facing slope, 24 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Grain Creek 150 m SW: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

plan: Drive: from City of Prince George, about 222 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 52.74813, -121.12681, pull off on Section 223 (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 7.6 km SW, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 997 m, about 252 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 220 m NW of the spot at 1,428 m (52.7015, -121.21094). Water: Grain Creek 90 m W (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 5-15, Region 5. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AB-bear-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 5-15: about 859 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.09 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
